industry.why: Neutral at industry level, carried, with the sector rows carrying the view. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): technology saw $5.5 billion of net selling in the week, the most since January 2025 (Jefferies, 17 Oct), the rotation came out of it, and Wood says 'the easy money in semis is made'; against that, Jefferies finds sector pockets still upgrading inside it (analogue chips, optical networking, artificial-intelligence memory) and Morgan Stanley still rates North American semiconductors Attractive. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: B now, B prior at industry level, carried by Semiconductors at A. The industry row stays C because the industry is split: Semiconductors (D), Software B2B Enterprise (D), Fintech (D) and Games (D) carry the Underweight; IT services, Hardware and vertical software stay Neutral. Counter-case for D: the heaviest net selling in 21 months is a regime statement; for B: the only industry with upgrades inside the sell-off.

memo.verdict: PROGRESS to Early-Stage Assessment. Direction bullish on the business, neutral on the entry point. Composite Decision grade [C]. The memo's own framing: a B-grade business carrying a C-grade entry point and a management-guided H2 2026 margin cut. The open question is price and timing, not business quality. Named gate: write Early-Stage Assessment AFTER the Q3 2026 interim report in late October 2026, so the gross-margin test is answered rather than assumed. Named progression condition: Element E3 (Sufficient total-shareholder-return / valuation upside) must be written against the live SEK 488.6 price before any capital view is formed. Park triggers carried from the evidence base: a Q3 or Q4 2026 gross margin below 61%, or book-to-bill below 0.95x for two consecutive quarters by Q4 2026. Conviction-raising trigger: a Q3 gross margin above 62.5% with the memory cost already absorbed.
case: Delivery congruency is the strongest single fact in the evidence base and grades A. FY2025 net sales of SEK 3,577m beat a SEK 3,140m target by SEK 437m or 13.92%. FY2025 adjusted EBIT margin of 25.5% beat a 20% original medium-term goal by 5.50 percentage points. Consensus EBIT margin was beaten in 15 of 17 quarters, an 88% rate against a 50-60% sector base rate. The few historical misses trace to planned internal projects such as enterprise-system go-lives costing roughly SEK 15m of postponed invoicing each, not to demand or integration failure.

The destocking cycle has demonstrably cleared rather than merely being asserted to have cleared. Backlog-to-sales returned to the pre-Covid 0.2x from a 0.65x peak. Q2 2026 was the clean test: SEK 979m of order intake, up 15% organically, with the SEK 130m Molex pull-forward entirely absent, and book-to-bill at 1.0x in constant currency. Backlog rebuilt to SEK 686m from a SEK 604m four-year low.

Internal change forces are unusually well dated, each carrying a date, a cost and a measured outcome. The seven-year matrix structure was dissolved on 1 January 2025 into three profit-accountable divisions, at SEK 25m of Q4 2024 restructuring cost for SEK 40m of run-rate savings, removing approximately 40 positions and cutting headcount by around 10%. Molex closed 2 January 2026 for USD 7m cash for a portfolio generating over USD 10m annually, contributing SEK 42m of sales and SEK 13m of EBIT in Q1 2026. Red Lion reached 23% adjusted EBIT margins by Q4 2025 from 57% gross margins at acquisition. A minority stake in Swedish artificial-intelligence developer Ekkono was taken in Q2 2026.
counter_case: There is no dedicated risks family report for HMS-SE. The memo states this as a real evidence gap, draws the risk picture from change-forces and earnings-review only, carries no peer's risk material across, and marks deep risk Elements E15 to E19 ungradeable as the correct scope position. It also declares that no 43-leadership-foundations family exists.

No source on disk states a park recommendation. The memo reconciles against each by name and date. change-forces (digest 30 July 2026, source vintage Q1 2026) records fourteen aggregate weak signals and a 24% joint probability on the full bull case, yet its own BLUF calls the case highly compelling. earnings-review (Q2 2026 print of 14 July 2026, report produced 12 August 2026) upgrades the case from cyclical recovery to structural compounder and states invalidation thresholds rather than a park instruction. business-foundations (digest 31 July 2026) records an explicit PASS with Business Foundation STRONG at 4.43 out of 5.00.
triggers: Q3 2026 gross margin, the near-term gate. Above 62.5% confirms cost pass-through and de-risks H2 delivery. Below 61.5% signals that fixed-price framework agreements prevent immediate pass-through. Below 61% in Q3 or Q4 2026 is a stated invalidation threshold. Q3 2026 interim report due late October 2026.
Book-to-bill. Expect above 1.00x; warning threshold below 0.95x. Below 0.95x for two consecutive quarters by Q4 2026 invalidates the demand-recovery thesis and is a stated park trigger.

Active design-win count. Last known 1,945 at end-2023. This is the designated early-warning instrument for the standardisation threat and the memo raises obtaining a current figure as a downstream action. A sustained decline over consecutive quarters signals deteriorating competitive position.
Cyber Resilience Act demand pull, unsized. Vulnerability reporting mandatory September 2026, full enforcement 11 December 2027. The memo requires this sized at Early-Stage Assessment.

Recurring revenue leg. Can the move from below 5% of net sales to above 10% be underwritten at all? The memo calls this the single largest unproven ask in the 2030 plan. The earnings-review's own non-consensus call is that recurring revenue could reach 12% to 14% of revenues by 2029.
Bolt-on deployment. Failure to deploy at least SEK 200m of bolt-on acquisition value during 2027 would suggest management cannot deploy balance-sheet capacity after deleveraging to 1.74x.
